purpose: Discover one uniquely smallest complete executable-organ assembly from explicit required interfaces and bindings, then publish it through the existing exact organ builder without fuzzy package selection or invented source.

properties.organ_goal: exact axm.interface-organ-goal/v0.1 object with id, version, project_type, required_interfaces, and explicit bindings keyed by provided interface
properties.checks: optional deterministic grounding checks over the composed project
properties.publish_mode: grounded-draft by default; validated when failed checks must block publication

relationships: starts from exact required interface names rather than package names
searches only installed executable-organ package provides/requires contracts compatible with the requested project type
selects only one uniquely smallest acyclic collision-free complete package set
derives dependency edges from exact transitive interface requirements
preserves explicit caller bindings and never invents package parameters or source
emits missing executable-organ contracts or ambiguity as typed HOLD evidence
delegates exact reference resolution, rendering, ownership, publication, and validation to existing organ machinery

anatomy_refs.basis: The planner treats exact provided and required interface names as bounded constraint edges and exposes every selected provider and dependency.
The selected organ set becomes an acyclic dependency graph derived from provider requirements, with redundant direct edges removed deterministically.
One exact interface goal deterministically compiles into an inspectable organ assembly recipe before existing creation machinery executes it.

limitations: interface names are exact declared contracts and do not prove source-level semantic conformance
a unique smallest complete package set selects only deterministic structural composition, not the best creative meaning
multiple equally small complete assemblies remain on HOLD rather than being ranked by hidden preferences
bindings must be supplied explicitly and exactly match the selected packages
missing interfaces emit contracts for later human, AI, recipe, or Forge work but do not synthesize source automatically
runtime imports, shared-file merging, browser behavior, and visual quality are not invented or proven

truth.basis: Compatible packages, search bound, candidates, selected refs, interface providers, dependencies, binding issues, missing contracts, and proof limits remain inspectable.

agency.basis: The caller supplies the required interfaces and every creative parameter value; ambiguity remains a choice rather than hidden automatic preference.

continuity.basis: The compiler reuses stable exact package refs and existing publication machinery without rewriting installed organ source.

wisdom-before-speed.basis: Only one complete unique minimal assembly may execute; missing, ambiguous, cyclic, colliding, or incompletely bound states remain typed HOLDs.
